When Icons Miss: Red-Carpet Styling Under Scrutiny in Seoul

Recent luxury appearances by Lee Na-young, Kim Tae-hee, and Son Ye-jin spark debate over proportion, hair, and star power.

BY HALLYUZINE SEOUL DESK • NOV 26, 2026
THE DOSSIER: KEY FACTS BRIEFING
  • Event: Lee Na-young attended an Italian jewelry brand photo call at Cove the Jangchung in Seoul.
  • Featured Stars: A-list Korean actresses Lee Na-young, Kim Tae-hee, and Son Ye-jin.
  • Key Venues: Cove the Jangchung and Seoul Auction's Gangnam Center in Sinsa-dong.

The Burden of Timeless Beauty

In South Korea's hyper-scrutinized luxury circuit, even the most celebrated A-listers are not immune to a styling misstep. This week, actress Lee Na-young became the latest focal point of fashion commentary following her appearance at a high-profile photo call for an Italian jewelry brand at Cove the Jangchung in Seoul. Known for her ethereal presence and effortless chic, Lee opted for a crisp white tailored suit paired with a gold necklace and statement rings. While the ensemble aimed for understated elegance, the oversized, loose-fitting silhouette ultimately overwhelmed her slender frame, sparking immediate debate among fashion watchers and fans alike.

Hair, Proportion, and Missed Opportunities

The critique extended beyond tailoring to her overall beauty direction. Lee's deeply parted hair, styled in thick waves cascading across one cheek, was clearly intended to evoke classic glamour. Yet, many observers noted that the heavy volume felt slightly stifling, obscuring the fresh, modern sophistication that has long defined her public persona. In the high-stakes world of luxury brand ambassadorships, where every angle is captured in unforgiving high definition, even a slight imbalance in proportion can inadvertently overshadow both the wearer and the fine jewelry itself.

A Pattern Among Seoul's Elite

Lee's appearance quickly revived broader conversations about recent red-carpet choices by fellow icons Kim Tae-hee and Son Ye-jin, both of whom have faced similar commentary when their event looks fell short of expectations. Just a month prior, Kim Tae-hee drew mixed reactions at a 90th-anniversary celebration for a prestigious jewelry house at Seoul Auction's Gangnam Center in Sinsa-dong, where she stepped out in an ivory strapless dress. Like Son Ye-jin's past scrutinized outings, the moment left fans wondering why veteran stylists occasionally struggle to complement Korea's most recognizable faces. Ultimately, the recurring debate highlights a simple truth in Seoul's luxury fashion scene: when natural star power is this commanding, the finest styling should simply step back and let it shine.
